Both searches ran in one executor wave with `distinctFiles:true`, `level:"chunk"`, `metaOnly:true`, `limit:3`, `filter:{presets:"production"}`, and `pathPattern:"**/tax_automations/**"`.

| Search kind | Relative path | Actual symbolId | Lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| semantic_search | app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/base_client.rb | `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::RateLimitedError#retry_after` | 121–129 |
| semantic_search | app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/operation_worker.rb | `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::OperationWorker.throttle_args` | 16–18 |
| semantic_search | app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb | `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::OperationWorker.global_retry_in` | 37–46 |
| hybrid_search | app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/base_client.rb | `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::BaseClient::RateLimitedError#retry_after` | 121–129 |
| hybrid_search | app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/transfer_bytes_to_presigned_target.rb | `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Documents::TransferBytesToPresignedTarget#perform` | 27–53 |
| hybrid_search | app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparations/merge_for_contact.rb | `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::TaxPreparations::MergeForContact#move_tax_automation_documents!` | 72–82 |

Each search returned three distinct files; one result overlaps. Semantic search returned symbols explicitly naming retry/throttling behavior. Hybrid search shared the top result but returned two broader workflow symbols.

Only locator metadata was gathered; no source bodies were read or files edited.
